hazards.name: Wide Driveway Conflict Zone
hazards.description: A very wide driveway for a parking lot creates a large area where pedestrians must cross vehicle paths without protection or clear priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Center background, across the street where the pedestrian is walking.

hazards.name: Embedded Tram Tracks
hazards.description: The metal rails embedded in the asphalt are a significant trip hazard for pedestrians and a slip or entrapment hazard for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway, running parallel to traffic

hazards.name: Wide Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The street is wide with multiple lanes of traffic and no marked crossings, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected over a long distance.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vans
hazards.description: Large vans parked on the right side of the street block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the travel lane.

hazards.name: Lack of marked mid-block crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians wishing to access the commercial storefronts from the opposite side of the street have no designated crossing point, potentially leading to unsafe mid-block crossings.

hazards.name: Blank frontage (vacant lot)
hazards.description: The fenced-in vacant lot reduces passive surveillance and creates a gap in the active streetscape, which can impact perceived safety.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image behind the fence

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The pedestrian crossing markings at the intersection are almost completely worn away, making the crossing point unclear to drivers.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic and tram tracks without a central refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the main road

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian refuge areas are visible in this mid-block section, requiring unprotected crossings.

hazards.name: Large vehicle obstruction
hazards.description: A large yellow truck is parked in the bike lane, severely limiting visibility for pedestrians attempting to cross and for drivers to see pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection ahead lacks visible crosswalk markings, increasing risk during street crossings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at potential crossing points to improve visibility and shorten crossing distance.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at nearby intersections to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Implement a consistent planting or furniture zone to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Dedicated Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Reallocating road space for bike lanes would narrow the travel lanes, potentially slowing traffic and providing a wider buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: If pedestrian volume warrants, install a marked mid-block crosswalk with appropriate signage and lighting.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with signage to provide a designated and safer path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Clear Walkway Maintenance
interventions.description: Ensure that outdoor seating and commercial displays maintain a minimum clear width for pedestrian movement and accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting focused on the sidewalk to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Maintenance
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and trim back vegetation to ensure a clear, accessible path of travel.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install trees or large planters in a furniture zone to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to any potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees or a planting strip to create a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also providing shade and traffic calming.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while also providing shade.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to provide a smooth, level walking surface and remove tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clear Zone Enforcement
interventions.description: Ensure that outdoor dining structures maintain a minimum clear width for pedestrian travel as per local accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the parking lot entrance to the minimum necessary, using curb extensions or bollards to define a narrower path for vehicles and a shorter crossing for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility 'continental' markings and appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Upgrade the painted bike lane to a protected facility using bollards or a raised curb to separate cyclists from motor vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage and potentially a pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe crossing between intersections.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or raised tables to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential/commercial mixed-use area.

interventions.title: Loading Zone Management
interventions.description: Designate specific loading zones to prevent large vehicles from parking in bike lanes or near intersections where they block visibility.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access Route
interventions.description: Provide a clearly marked, ADA-compliant temporary walkway around the construction site to ensure continuous pedestrian access.
